about.legislature: Parliament: Chamber of Deputies (331) and Senate (136)

offices.President: Elected for five years in two rounds: a candidate who wins more than half of the registered voters is elected in the first round, otherwise the top two meet in a run-off two weeks later. The president represents the state, nominates the prime minister and leads defence and foreign policy.
offices.Chamber of Deputies: The deputies are elected for four years by party-list proportional representation in 43 constituencies (the 41 counties, Bucharest and the diaspora), with a 5% threshold for parties and higher ones for alliances; national minority organisations that pass a much lower threshold get one seat each. With the Senate it passes laws and the budget and can dismiss the government.
offices.Senate: The 136 senators are elected for four years by party-list proportional representation in the same 43 constituencies, with the same thresholds. It shares lawmaking with the Chamber of Deputies, and the two chambers meet jointly to vote confidence in the government.
